tool_schemas.name: upsert_entities
tool_schemas.description: Upserts a batch of entities into the knowledge graph and returns the created/updated entity records; entities are addressed by unique `name` and include `entityType`, `observations`, and optional `context`. If `update` is false, an item is created only when the name does not already exist; if `update` is true, an existing entity with that name is fully replaced. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided, and raises CONFLICT when `update` is false and an entity with the same name already exists.

observations.description: Facts or observations about the entity

context.description: Optional context or situation relevant to this entity (e.g., project, meeting, or scenario)

update.description: If true, will fully replace an existing entity; if false, will only create if entity doesn't exist

entities.description: Array of entities to create or update

tool_schemas.name: create_relations
tool_schemas.description: Creates a batch of directed relations (`from` → `to`) with a `relationType` and returns the created relation records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any relation is missing required fields/has empty strings or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when either endpoint entity name does not exist, and raises CONFLICT when an identical relation already exists.

tool_schemas.name: add_observations
tool_schemas.description: Appends new observation strings to existing entities and returns the updated entity records (or the observations added) for each input item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `entityName`/`contents` are missing, empty, or include unknown fields, or if any observation is not a string. Raises NOT_FOUND when `entityName` does not match an existing entity.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to add observations to

contents.description: Observations to add to the entity

observations.description: Array of entity observations to add

tool_schemas.name: delete_entities
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified entities and removes any relations associated with them, returning a summary of deletions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `entityNames` is missing, contains empty names, or includes unknown fields. Raises NOT_FOUND when any requested entity name does not exist.

entityNames.description: Array of entity names to delete

tool_schemas.name: delete_observations
tool_schemas.description: Removes specific observation strings from the specified entities and returns the updated entity records (or a per-entity removal summary). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, unknown fields are provided, or observations are not strings. Raises NOT_FOUND when the entity does not exist, and raises NOT_FOUND when a specified observation is not present on that entity.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to remove observations from

observations.description: Observations to remove from the entity

deletions.description: Array of entity observations to delete

tool_schemas.name: delete_relations
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a batch of relations identified by (`from`,`to`,`relationType`) and returns a summary of deletions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when a specified relation does not exist (including when `from`/`to` do not correspond to existing entities).

tool_schemas.name: read_graph
tool_schemas.description: Returns the complete knowledge graph, including all entities (with observations/context) and all relations; results are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if unexpected parameters are provided. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access to the graph is not permitted.

dummy.description: Placeholder parameter - this tool doesn't require parameters but returns the complete knowledge graph with entities and relationships

tool_schemas.name: search_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Searches entities in the knowledge graph by the provided `query` string and returns the matching nodes; results are returned as a single set and are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access to the graph is not permitted.

query.description: Search query to find matching entities

tool_schemas.name: open_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the specified entities by `names` and returns their full node records (including observations/context and any available relation info); results are returned as a single set and are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `names` is missing, contains empty strings, or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when any requested name does not exist.

names.description: Array of entity names to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: update_relations
tool_schemas.description: Updates a batch of existing relations identified by (`from`,`to`,`relationType`) and returns the updated relation records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when a specified relation does not already exist (or when `from`/`to` do not correspond to existing entities), and raises CONFLICT when the requested update would duplicate an existing relation.

tool_schemas.name: memory_query
tool_schemas.description: Searches stored observations (memories) using optional filters (keyword text match, created-by agent, tag, and ISO-8601 time window via before/after) and returns up to `limit` matching observations. Results are returned as a single page limited by `limit` (no cursor-based pagination is supported on this endpoint). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter value is malformed (e.g., non-ISO dates) or unknown fields are provided, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to read memories.

keyword.description: Text to search for in observations

before.description: ISO date to filter observations before

after.description: ISO date to filter observations after

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tool_schemas.name: think
tool_schemas.description: Appends a structured thinking entry to the Think Tank thinking log and returns the recorded entry; if `storeInMemory` is true, it also persists the thought as an observation optionally associated with `associateWithEntity`. This endpoint does not perform external research unless `allowResearch` is enabled and a `researchQuery` is provided, and it never modifies tasks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/too short or enums are invalid, NOT_FOUND when `associateWithEntity` refers to an entity that does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot write to the log or memory store.

structuredReasoning.description: A structured thought process to work through complex problems. Use this as a dedicated space for reasoning step-by-step.

associateWithEntity.description: Optional entity name to associate this thought with

tags.description: Optional tags to help categorize and find this thought later

storeInMemory.description: Whether to store this thought in the knowledge graph memory

context.description: Optional context or situation relevant to this thought (e.g., project, meeting, or scenario)

plannedSteps.description: The total number of steps planned for this thinking process

currentStep.description: The current step number in the thinking process

selfReflect.description: Whether to perform a self-reflection pass after generating the answer

allowResearch.description: Whether to allow research via external tools during the reasoning process

reflectPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the self-reflection stage

researchQuery.description: Optional research query to execute during the reasoning process

formatOutput.description: Whether to apply markdown formatting to the output

formatType.description: The type of formatting to apply

tool_schemas.name: plan_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks from the provided `tasks` array, generates server-side task IDs, stores `sourcePlanId` on each created task, and syncs the tasks to the knowledge graph; returns the list of newly created tasks with their assigned IDs. Tasks are created in a single request without pagination, and each task may optionally link to an existing entity via `entityId`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including invalid ULID formats or invalid `dueAt`), NOT_FOUND if any provided `entityId` does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not allowed to create tasks.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to create from a plan (IDs generated server-side).

sourcePlanId.description: External plan identifier to store on each created task.

tool_schemas.name: list_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks matching the optional filters (`status`, `priority`, `entityId`) and returns a paged result set ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder` up to `limit`. Pagination is cursor-based: pass the returned opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page until no further cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, malformed IDs, out-of-range limits, or unknown fields, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to list tasks.

entityId.description: Filter tasks by linked entity id (tt_ent_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: next_task
tool_schemas.description: Selects the next available highest-priority task in `todo` status (optionally restricted to a specific `entityId`), transitions it to `in_progress`, and returns the updated task. If no eligible task exists, it returns NOT_FOUND. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed `entityId`, NOT_FOUND if the provided `entityId` does not exist, CONFLICT if the selected task cannot be transitioned to `in_progress` due to its current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks.

entityId.description: If provided, selects the next task only among tasks linked to this entity.

tool_schemas.name: complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified task as `completed` and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `taskId` is malformed, NOT_FOUND if no task exists for `taskId`, CONFLICT if the task cannot transition to `completed` from its current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to update tasks.

taskId.description: Task id to mark completed (tt_tsk_... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: update_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Applies updates to multiple tasks and returns the updated tasks after setting any provided fields (title, details, priority, status, dueAt, entityId). This endpoint performs a batch update in a single response without pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, invalid date-time values, or unknown fields, NOT_FOUND if any referenced task (or any newly linked `entityId`) does not exist, CONFLICT if a requested status change is not allowed from the task’s current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks.

tasks.description: Array of task updates to apply.

dueAt.description: New due date/time (ISO 8601), or null to clear.

entityId.description: New linked entity id (tt_ent_... ULID), or null to unlink.

tool_schemas.name: show_memory_path
tool_schemas.description: Returns the absolute path to the currently active Think Tank knowledge graph storage location. This endpoint is not paged and returns a single string value. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to view environment/storage configuration and VALIDATION_ERROR if unexpected fields are provided.

tool_schemas.name: exa_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a web search via the Exa API for `query` with optional constraints (result count, search `type`, publish-date window, domain allow/deny lists, `category`, and `live_crawl`) and returns up to `num_results` results. Results are returned as a single page capped by `num_results` (no cursor-based pagination is supported on this endpoint) and the request/response are recorded for traceability and reuse. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums, out-of-range `num_results`, malformed dates, or unknown fields; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if Exa access is not enabled for the caller; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the Exa request budget/rate limit is exhausted.

type.description: Search type: auto (default), keyword (exact matching), or neural (semantic search)

start_published_date.description: Filter results published after this date (ISO format)

end_published_date.description: Filter results published before this date (ISO format)

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains

live_crawl.description: When to use live crawling: 'always' or 'fallback' (when cached not available)

tool_schemas.name: exa_answer
tool_schemas.description: Ask a question and get a sourced answer via Exa /answer API.

question.description: The question to ask and get an answer with sources

max_citations.description: Maximum number of citations to include in the answer (1-10)

tool_schemas.name: list_entities
tool_schemas.description: Lists active entities in the knowledge graph with optional filtering and pagination. Returns entity records ordered by `updated_at` desc by default; refuses invalid filters and will not return deleted entities.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against `name` (and optionally `entityType` when `searchInEntityType=true`).

entityType.description: Filter to entities with an exact `entity_type` match.

searchInEntityType.description: If true, `q` is matched against both `name` and `entity_type`.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

includeObservations.description: If true, includes active observations for each returned entity.

tool_schemas.name: get_entity
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single active entity by `id`. Returns the entity record and optionally its active observations and relations; refuses requests for deleted or unknown entities.

includeObservations.description: If true, includes active observations for the entity.

includeRelations.description: If true, includes active relations where this entity is `from` or `to`.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates a task by `id`, enforcing task lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated task; refuses invalid status transitions (e.g., completed→todo) and rejects unknown fields.

status.description: New task status; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

entityId.description: Associate the task with an entity by id.

tool_schemas.name: update_activity_log
tool_schemas.description: Updates an activity log by `id`, allowing only lifecycle state transitions for `status` and limited metadata edits. Returns the updated activity log; refuses invalid transitions and unknown fields.

status.description: New activity status; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

errorMessage.description: Error message to record when setting status to `failed`.

response.description: Structured response payload to persist on the log.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the activity log.

memoryPath.description: Absolute memory path associated with this log, if applicable.

tool_schemas.name: list_activity_logs
tool_schemas.description: Lists activity logs for traceability with optional filtering and pagination. Returns logs ordered by `created_at` desc; refuses invalid filters and unknown fields.

entityId.description: Filter to logs associated with a specific entity id.

tag.description: Filter to logs containing this tag.

since.description: Only return logs created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

until.description: Only return logs created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

metadata.name: Think Tank
metadata.description: Think Tank stores a local knowledge graph of entities, their observations (facts/memories), and directed relations between entities. It also maintains a lightweight task system synced to the graph, logs structured “thinking” sessions (optionally persisted as memory), and records Exa web search/answe
